companies.china: Third-quarter growth reflected a less buoyant environment in China, which hit Fashion & Leather Goods. Asia excluding Japan went from +4% in the second quarter to −5% in the third, while the United States, Europe and Japan grew.

guidance.text: No numeric guidance. LVMH says it remains confident and expects to reinforce its global leadership in luxury goods in 2026.

companies.name: Kering
companies.china: Lower store traffic weighed on Asia Pacific, particularly Mainland China, and on Japan for Gucci. Gucci's own retail sales fell 9% on a comparable basis.

guidance.text: Kering set a 2026 objective to return to growth and improve margins. In October it confirmed the objective of improving its recurring operating margin.
guidance.evidence: Nine-month revenue is flat on a comparable basis (Q1 0%, Q2 +2%, Q3 −1%). First-half recurring operating margin was 12.8%, up 40 basis points.
guidance.read: Margin on track at the half year. Growth has yet to show over nine months.

companies.name: Burberry
companies.fiscal: Financial year ends in late March. Calendar Q3 2026 is Burberry's Q2 FY27.
companies.scope: Series and regions are comparable retail sales: stores open for a year, at constant exchange rates. Retail is about 85% of revenue. Burberry reports Asia in two parts. Greater China is shown in the Asia column. The rest of Asia Pacific, which includes Japan and South Korea, grew 3% in each of the last three quarters and has no matching column.
companies.china: Greater China comparable retail sales grew 5% in the quarter, after 9% in the quarter before. Burberry's Greater China covers Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan.

guidance.text: Expects further progress on its financial ambitions in FY27, with revenue growth and margin expansion, while mindful of an uncertain geopolitical and macroeconomic environment.

companies.name: Zegna Group
companies.scope: Zegna reports Asia in two parts. The Greater China Region is shown in the Asia column. The rest of Asia Pacific, which includes Japan and South Korea, grew 5.0% in the third quarter and 19.3% in the second, and has no matching column.
companies.china: The Greater China Region grew 5.7% organically, after 8.6% in the second quarter. Management described steady growth there in a more challenging environment, and said the slowdown weighed on Thom Browne.

guidance.text: No numeric guidance. Management looks to the final months of the year with cautious confidence in an uncertain environment.

companies.name: Brunello Cucinelli
companies.scope: Brunello Cucinelli publishes second-quarter sales only inside the half year, so the second quarters are left empty. First-half revenues grew 13.3% at constant rates in 2026 and 10.7% in 2025. Regions are published for the year to date and not for the quarter, so the region columns are empty. The fourth quarter of 2024 is left out because the company gave that figure without a constant-rate basis.
companies.china: Brunello Cucinelli reports strong growth in China and names it as a significant contributor to Asia. The company gives no growth figure for China or for Asia in the quarter.

guidance.text: Revenue growth of 12% at constant exchange rates in 2026, raised from a range of 10% to 11% in July. Around 10% in 2027.
guidance.evidence: Growth at constant rates was 13.3% in the first half and 13.5% in the third quarter.
guidance.read: Ahead of the full-year target after nine months.

companies.name: Ferragamo
companies.scope: Group growth is total revenues. The regions are net sales. Central and South America grew 0.7% in the third quarter and 6.5% in the second, and has no matching column.
companies.china: Ferragamo said the market weakened during the third quarter, with the trend in Asia deteriorating further, in particular in China. Asia Pacific net sales fell 11.1% at constant rates, after a 0.6% decline in the second quarter.

guidance.text: No numeric guidance. The group says it remains confident in its medium to long-term direction and will keep executing with discipline amid macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty.
guidance.evidence: Third-quarter revenues fell 3.5% at constant rates, after growth of 4.6% in the second quarter.
